reddit.content:
Try separating listening from speaking: first identify a few light/night examples without repeating them, then practise the pair you keep mixing up.

I built L & N because I confuse these sounds myself. It has short listening rounds and recording/replay practice in English, Mandarin and Cantonese. You can see what the recognizer heard rather than relying on a score alone. It’s practice feedback, not a speech assessment.

iPhone/iPad — US$0.99:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/l-n-speech-practice/id6808872450

Android — free download, with in-app purchases:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=art.lazying.landn
